title: B2B SaaS Growth System
description: Full Q1/Q2 growth architecture for a B2B SaaS: ICP refinement, outbound system, CRM operating model, SEO foundation, and CRO layer. Built and run as an integrated system, not a set of campaigns.
problem: Sporadic campaigns without a connected system — no ICP definition, no CRM operating model, no attribution, no compounding motion.
system: End-to-end revenue architecture: ICP and persona work, outbound sequence system, CRM pipeline design, SEO content foundation, and CRO audit across the acquisition funnel.
artifact: Running growth system — operating playbooks, CRM configuration, sequence templates, dashboards, and a weekly operating cadence.
outcome: Structured GTM motion replacing ad-hoc campaigns. Pipeline stages measurable for the first time.
